summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Analysis S.A. institutional site. All 6 routes, navigation, CTAs, contact form, blog navigation, hash-scroll to guarantee anchors, WhatsApp floating button, mobile menu, and footer verified successfully. No console/page errors detected. No backend integration (frontend-only site as requested).

integration_issues.issue: The custom toast 'Preencha nome, e-mail e mensagem.' never fires because the HTML5 `required` attribute on name/email/message inputs blocks form submission first. The JS-level validation in submit() is effectively dead code. Functionally OK (browser shows native tooltip), but the design intent of a Sonner error toast is not delivered. To fix: remove the `required` attribute and rely on the JS validation + toast, OR remove the JS check.

issues: CONTACT.whatsapp in /app/frontend/src/data/site.js is a placeholder '5511999999999' — must be replaced with the real Analysis S.A. WhatsApp number before launch.
Footer 'Modalidades' shows only 6 of 8 guarantees (slice(0,6)). Concorrência and Compra/Venda de Energia are not linked from footer. Confirm with client if intentional.

critical_code_review_comments: Home.jsx is ~500 lines — could split hero, advantages, guarantees-bento, cta, blog-teaser into smaller components for maintainability.
Hash scroll in Garantias.jsx uses setTimeout 200ms — works, but consider using `scroll-mt-28` (already present) plus a CSS `scroll-behavior:smooth` on html for native UX.
Form 'value' field accepts free text — consider a currency mask for better data quality.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is frontend-only. Public preview URL: https://moderno-finance-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Use data-testid selectors documented in review_request. Verified: home (hero/stats/6 advantages/8 guarantees/3 blog teasers), header sticky + CTA, all 6 NAV routes, /carta-de-fianca, hash-scroll #licitacoes from home guarantee card works, blog list + post + back-to-blog, contact form submit success toast (Sonner), modality Select dropdown, WhatsApp floating button expands card with wa.me href, mobile hamburger nav, footer with 6 nav + 6 guarantee links, 404 page. Known minor: HTML5 required preempts custom toast for empty submit; WhatsApp number is placeholder.
rca_of_the_issue: Empty-submit toast unreachable: Form uses both `required` HTML5 attribute and `if (!form.name ...) toast.error(...)`. Browsers stop submission at the first invalid required field and show the native bubble, so the JS handler never runs for empty fields. Mitigation: remove `required` from name/email/message inputs (keep the JS check) to use Sonner toast consistently, or simply rely on the native HTML5 validation and delete the JS check.
